sentences.en: If it should rain tomorrow, the excursion will be canceled.
sentences.zh: 如果明天下雨，这次远足可能会取消。

sentences.en: I am looking forward very much to the school excursion.
sentences.zh: 我非常期待学校的这次短途旅游。

sentences.en: Miroslav was really excited about his upcoming excursion to Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 米罗斯拉夫对即将去越南的旅行兴奋不已。

senses.zh: （尤指集体）远足,短途旅行，游览,离题,机冲程

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ex（出）+curs（跑）+ion（表动作）→跑出去→短途旅行
